skills.name: pymizu
skills.description: Write correct Python code for async and parallel computing with pymizu: task pools, parallel map, channels and asyncio over shared memory on one machine. Use when the user wants to run Python code in parallel or in the background, speed up a loop, escape the GIL with processes, use asyncio or concurrent.futures, share data with Python or R processes, or convert from multiprocessing, joblib, Ray or Dask. Single machines only: pymizu has no remote workers.
